notes.title: Update:"LingTian1" Changed to Static Images and More
notes.notes:
[h2]Main Updates for Otome Game Series "1000 Princes":[/h2]

[h3]1. "LingTian1" Changed to Static Images[/h3]
Both the demo and full versions of the game originally featured short dynamic video clips. However, due to each clip being under 1 second and looping repeatedly, they caused severe screen jitter, leading to poor visual feedback from players. As a result, all 1,050 MP4-format video clips in "LingTian1" have been converted into static images.

Originally, the video length, frame rate, and size were deliberately reduced to meet Google Play's AAB size limit. This compromise negatively affected visual quality. Moving forward, I will focus on enhancing the quality of static images in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/5d15b2207d21c725116369a470cb71fe3f5ee3c9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/fc21ea0b4697ce738c2c3ffcea16fabbcfd9c763.png[/img]

[quote=author]
[h3]What's the Difference Between "LingTian1" Demo and the "LingTian" Clips in "1000 Princes"?[/h3]
Both versions allow players to experience part of the gameplay. The "LingTian1" demo provides a continuous portion of the game—from Chapter 1 to Chapter X—with complete story progression, branching options, and full functionality.

On the other hand, the "LingTian1" clips in the shared route of "1000 Princes" feature disconnected romantic scenes from the game. These clips are not continuous, and option buttons do not display branching storylines.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/3a54e4bfa060c6ca691f0177ce1a8fe5cb36f2fc.png[/img]
[/quote]

[h3]2. Icon Update[/h3]
To make games easier to identify, I've updated the icons. For example, "LingTian1" now features a solo portrait of the prince. His name, such as "LingTian", is displayed at the bottom of the icon in the game's main UI color. The top right corner features a sequence tag like "1". If it's a demo version, a green diagonal ribbon appears on the top left.

The "1000 Princes" game, which serves as the shared storyline for all the princes and the player, has a group photo icon featuring multiple princes. The bottom label reads "1000 + Crown", and the background is rainbow-colored, representing the union of all princes. The top right corner includes a rainbow sequence tag. Demo versions have a green ribbon on the top left.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/973fc66051b920160e335696644106e1c0b98c63.png[/img]

notes.title: "LingTian1" v2.0 Fully Retranslated Version Released
notes.notes:
[This Update Contents]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/1ab90b17800291e6213c49e67ebb40931117f78b.png[/img]
1. Full Foreign Language Texts Fully Re-translated
In the previous versions of "Ling Tian 1" Full Version and Demo, due to technical constraints, only machine translation could be used. In this update, AI translation has been fully implemented. The game scripts have been re-translated into 13 languages: English, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, French, Russian, Turkish, Thai, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Italian, and Portuguese. This makes the dialogue between you and the prince more fluent, the text expression clearer and more accurate, allowing the visual novel script to be better understood by players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/e951aee60d6d5170e43566d99be7b0d5ec1e9464.png[/img]
2. UI Update
After the player clicks on the icon of the Prince of Ling Tian waving at you on the right side, a quick panel with gold buttons will be displayed. The new update adds a [Settings] button to the quick panel, allowing players to conveniently adjust settings, including choosing languages, adjusting music and sound volumes, and controlling the dialogue speed.

3. SKIP Fast-Forward Function Improvement
In the old version, the fast-forward feature only allowed players to skip over the game script that had already been read. With this update, players can directly skip over content they haven't read yet, making it easier to browse quickly. However, selection buttons and mini-games cannot be skipped.

4. Game Level Improvement
In the previous versions of "Ling Tian 1" Full Version and Demo, some game levels required players to save the ongoing main storyline, go to other rooms of the prince to find clues and answers, then return to the main game to enter a password before continuing. This complex design made the game tedious. In the new version, the difficulty is reduced, allowing players to find answers without leaving the main storyline. 
This otome game, "Ling Tian 1," has undergone a comprehensive difficulty reduction. Previously, due to difficult password clues and answers, players couldn't pass the game and even thought it was a bug caused by poor developer skills. Therefore, changes have been made. The new version shows a "Give me a hint" or "Love cheat" button, allowing players to pass easily and enjoy the sweet and happy moments of falling in love with the Prince of Ling Tian while playing the game casually!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915360/5ae5dae8cdd31dd1e5b797a0a1a050bf3ecdb580.png[/img]
5. Name Input Box
The default name for the heroine, ABC123, can be modified in two ways, and names in various languages such as Thai can be entered in the text box. 
a. Click the red pencil on the homepage to directly modify the name, which will immediately display on the homepage.
b. Click the red silhouette of the girl on the homepage to display your name and points table. Click the red pencil to modify the name, but the new name will only appear after returning to the homepage.
